additional_info.subject: Additional description:
additional_info.body:
Hello,
Today 3 of February a client tried to charge with POS 3 times between 6:10 PM and 6:50 PM CU TIME but there was no energy delivery. After the authorization was accepted the screen showed "error" or "impossible to charge". He tried to charge with an App but the App also showed "error", then he tried again two times with our APP and the second attempt was successful. The recharge started correctly at 6:47 PM CU TIME.
Can you please check the logs to help us better understand what happened?
Thank you

additional_info.body:
Dear Rosita,
Following your report and after completing our checks, we have identified that the issue was related to the charger being unable to reach the dispenser.
As shown in the attached logs, one of the main breakers had tripped:
At this stage, we will continue to monitor the charger. If the main breaker error occurs again, we will proceed with a site visit and proceed with the replacement if required.
Should you require any additional information or assistance in the meantime, please do not hesitate to contact us.
Kind regards,
Anass Mezzaoui
eMobility Technical Support Team
